format: bplist00 metadata subset: strings, integers, booleans, arrays and dictionaries
scope: Decode and inspect all string objects and dictionary keys. No target deserialization or execution. Opaque data, UID/keyed archives and unsupported types remain coverage gaps.
framing: Exact offset table and trailer, full record consumption, reachable acyclic object graph, unique string dictionary keys, bounded depth/counts/text.
tests: 12 regressions, including 1000 seeded byte mutations checked against the independent stdlib parser, executable masquerading, duplicate keys, cycles, opaque payloads and malformed framing.
